This repo contains a metadata driven lifecycle detection and validation framework.

The engine is designed to automatically detect each transaction scenario and save it into datalake for further analysis and validation and regression testing.

The framework leverages metadata to understand the structure and relationships within the data, enabling efficient and accurate detection of lifecycle events.

Business rules are defined in metadata rather than hard-coded in the processing logic. 

This approach allows for greater flexibility and easier maintenance, as changes to business rules can be made without modifying the underlying code.

The framework also supports automated validation and regression testing, ensuring that any changes to the metadata or business rules do not introduce errors or inconsistencies in the lifecycle detection process.

Overall, this metadata-driven approach enhances the robustness, adaptability, and maintainability of the lifecycle detection and validation framework.
